key_insight: ProIQA assesses math item quality by combining problem-stem understanding with the full solution process, enabling finer-grained evaluation than stem-only or manual-review methods.
engineering_relevance: It provides a scalable framework for validating automatically generated math items in intelligent tutoring and education systems, especially where reasoning quality matters.
method: Formulates item quality assessment across knowledge concepts, difficulty, and disciplinary competencies under a process-aware view.
Augments item data with structured reasoning trees derived from raw solutions.
Uses LLMs to build hierarchical reasoning trees and GNNs plus a dual-view "Stem + Solving" architecture to fuse process and stem semantics.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive experiments on K12 math datasets, showing ProIQA captures process-oriented features and improves fine-grained assessment of AIG outputs.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality and consistency of LLM-generated reasoning trees, which could add preprocessing cost and noise.
paper_title: ProIQA: A Process-Based Framework for Fine-Grained Math Item Quality Assessment
